description: Java class implementing a command handler for associating clients to a group within the Fineract project. It processes commands to link multiple clients to a specified group.

classes.name: AssociateClientsToGroupCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring Service class that handles commands to associate multiple clients to a specific group via the write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming command to associate clients with a group by delegating to the write platform service.
